name: API Toolkit
description: A developer framework for building custom JSON API endpoints: typed request classes with Symfony validation, standardised JSON responses, and cached entity normalizations.
project_description: API Toolkit is a developer tool that reduces the boilerplate of hand-building custom API endpoints in Drupal, for cases where core JSON:API is not the right fit. It provides three main building blocks: (1) domain-specific request classes (extending ApiRequestBase) whose typed public properties are auto-filled from POST bodies, query parameters and route attributes, then validated with Symfony's validator using type hints, default values, enums and constraint attributes; (2) standardised JSON response classes (JsonResponse, PagedJsonResponse and their Cacheable variants) that nest payloads under a 'data' key and add 'pagination'/'links' for paged results, plus automatic standardised error responses for validation failures on configured route formats; and (3) a CachedNormalizer service that caches and auto-invalidates individual entity/field normalizations, with a placeholder system for dynamic or nested values. It also ships custom validation constraints (EntityExists, EntityUnique, Enum, Langcode, MigrationSourceExists), an entity-UUID param converter, and .po translations for validation messages. The module does nothing on its own; it is consumed from custom module code.
